summary: This note describes the song "Through the Eyes of Love" (also known as "Theme from Ice Castles"), a ballad performed by American singer Melissa Manchester. It comes from the soundtrack of the 1978 film Ice Castles and received nominations for an Academy Award and a Golden Globe Award. The note also mentions that the title is sometimes incorrectly given as "Looking Through the Eyes of Love."
